inj_report.short: Cooper caught two of six targets for 19 yards Sunday in a Week 8 loss to Washington.
inj_report.long: Both of Cooper's catches came in the first half -- he didn't haul in any of his three targets in the second half. The second-year wideout led Eagles wideouts with 66 offensive snaps and finished second with the six targets, but it didn't amount to much production, as he couldn't form much of a connection with QB Tanner McKee. Despite an elevated role due to injuries to DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) the past two weeks, Cooper has just three catches for 36 yards in that span, making him an unappealing fantasy option.

inj_report.short: Singletary is expected to handle a bigger role out of the Giants' backfield after Tyrone Tracy (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.
inj_report.long: The Giants have their bye in Week 8, but Tracy will be required to miss at least four games with his injury, so it appears Singletary and Cam Skattebo (hamstring) will form the backfield duo with Tracy sidelined and Najee Harris recently released. Singletary scored the game-winning touchdown in overtime last Sunday against the Texans, finishing with 55 total yards and the touchdown on eight touches. If Skattebo is healthy, he figures to operate as the lead back, but Singletary showed enough to warrant 6-to-10 touches with upside for more. He's worth picking up in most fantasy leagues.

inj_report.short: Flournoy caught three of four targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 33-30 overtime loss to the Cardinals.
inj_report.long: Flournoy ran 26 routes on Dak Prescott's 38 dropbacks against Arizona, and with Dallas moving more toward three-wide sets and away from multiple tight-end sets while decreasing Jake Ferguson's (ankle) playing time, Flournoy has been a big beneficiary in recent weeks. Over the last four weeks, Flournoy has recorded 238 yards and two touchdowns on 18 grabs across 21 targets. He's achieved WR4 valuation in fantasy and would receive a major boost if CeeDee Lamb or George Pickens ever went down with an injury.

inj_report.short: Sampson rushed one time for seven yards and caught six of eight targets for 62 yards in Sunday's 27-6 loss to the Steelers.
inj_report.long: Sampson was out-carried 11 to one by Quinshon Judkins, but the former has carved out a role as the preferred pass-catching back for Cleveland since returning from injured reserve in Week 7. Over the last two games, Sampson has turned 11 targets into nine catches for 94 yards while adding seven carries for 52 yards. Sampson will have some PPR fantasy appeal during weeks when the Browns are projected to trail on the scoreboard.

inj_report.long: In his second game back from a multi-week high-ankle sprain, Douglas led the team with 31 routes on Malik Willis' 36 dropbacks against New England. The rookie wideout's six targets tied Greg Dulcich and Malik Washington for the team lead on a day when Willis targeted nine different pass catchers. Through four games this season, Douglas has 13 grabs for 226 yards and two touchdowns on 19 targets. He's a low-volume, big-play threat on the outside for Miami, but Douglas will be in the mix as a streamer for next Sunday's date with a leaky Lions secondary.

Hockenson scored a go-ahead touchdown two plays later. Addison's eight targets on the day were one fewer than Justin Jefferson, but it was the former who paced the team in receiving yards. He'll be a fantasy WR4 with upside next Monday night against a leaky Bills secondary.

inj_report.long: Most of his production came on a nifty 48-yard catch-and-run in the fourth quarter, as Douglas took a strike from Drake Maye along the sideline but then curled back toward the middle of the field and dashed the remaining 30 yards to the end zone while out-racing four Miami defenders. It was the fourth touchdown of the season for the fourth-year wideout, a new career high, and Douglas will take a 26-332-4 line on 37 targets through eight games into a Week 9 tilt against the Packers.

inj_report.long: The veteran tight end paced the Texans with his six targets, matching Xavier Hutchinson, as the duo saw one more than Nico Collins on a day when C.J. Stroud targeted nine different pass catchers. Schultz is still looking for his first touchdown of the season and has settled in as a low-ceiling fantasy tight end.

Overall, he's mustered just a 17-182-0 line on 24 targets in his five appearances this season, but 15 of his catches have occurred in the four full contests for Jayden Daniels in 2026, so the tight end has exhibited a rapport with the team's primary signal-caller. Okonkwo will aim for a bounceback this coming Sunday against the Rams.

inj_report.short: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak said Wednesday that the breakdown in carries between Washington and Ashton Jeanty will be determined on a week-to-week basis, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.
inj_report.long: Per Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com, Kubiak said that he "absolutely" believes that Jeanty can be a bell cow running back, but at least for the time being, he looks like he'll be part of a timeshare with Washington. Jeanty has seen his carry count drop or hold steady in each successive game since Week 1, culminating in the 2025 first-round pick logging just two carries in this past Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets, while Washington carried a career-high 25 times for 83 yards. The split in carries may not be quite as dramatic in weeks to come, but Washington appears to have earned himself a sizable piece of the pie while he's averaging 4.3 yards per tote to Jeanty's 3.1 mark through eight games. Jeanty remains the Raiders' clear cut top option on passing downs over Washington, who has recorded just three receptions for 11 yards on six targets so far this season.

inj_report.long: Dulcich has yet to score a touchdown this season, but the tight end is settling in as one of Malik Willis' favorite targets. He has at least four catches in four of his last five games but has reached 50 receiving yards in just two of seven contests. Dulcich is in the large bucket of low-floor, low-ceiling TE2 options in fantasy, but he does get a plus Week 9 draw against the Lions.

inj_report.short: Vele caught all five of his targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers.
inj_report.long: The third-year wideout was on the other end of Tyler Shough's only TD pass of the day, hauling in a one-yard toss in the second quarter for the Saints' final points. Vele tied his career high with his third touchdown of the season, and his 33-348-3 line on 48 targets through seven games has him tracking toward a career-best campaign heading into a Week 8 bye. His role could shrink significantly after the bye, however, if rookie Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) is cleared to make his NFL debut.

inj_report.short: Robinson (ankle) practiced on a limited basis Thursday.
inj_report.long: Since the 49ers designated him for return from injured reserve Wednesday, Robinson has logged back-to-back capped sessions. GM John Lynch said Thursday on KNBR radio that the 49ers expect Robinson to be available Sunday against the Raiders, which can't be said for fellow WRs Mike Evans (Achilles) and Deebo Samuel (hamstring), per Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area. Friday's injury report will reveal Robinson's odds to return this weekend, but he'll still need to be activated by Saturday afternoon to have a chance to do so.

inj_timeline.note: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Thursday that Robinson (ankle) has an "outside chance" to return from injured reserve for the 49ers' Week 7 game versus the Falcons but is more likely to be activated following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.
49ers coach Kyle Shanahan reiterated Monday that Robinson (ankle) has a chance to return following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

inj_report.short: Lemon caught six of nine targets for 57 yards in Sunday's 27-10 loss to the Commanders.
inj_report.long: Lemon has stepped up as Philadelphia's de facto No. 1 receiver in the ongoing absences of DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle). After setting career highs across the board with seven catches for 67 yards and his first NFL touchdown on eight targets in Week 7 against the Cowboys, Lemon led the Eagles in catches, receiving yards and targets Sunday night. The rookie 20th overall pick is building momentum ahead of a Week 9 home game against the Giants, but his target share would likely drop if Smith gains clearance to return.

inj_report.short: Mayer caught five of six targets for 53 yards in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.
inj_report.long: Mayer's six targets were second on the team behind Brock Bowers' 10, and only Bowers (26) ran more routes than Mayer's 20 on Kirk Cousins' 27 dropbacks. The tight end has just one touchdown this season but has remained an integral part of Las Vegas' passing attack. He's already surpassed his 2025 catches and yards totals, posting 36 grabs for 351 yards through eight games this season. Mayer will be a fantasy TE2 for next Sunday's date with the 49ers.

inj_report.short: Barner brought in two of five targets for 23 yards in the Seahawks' 34-17 loss to the Bears on Monday night.
inj_report.long: Barner was third in receiving yards and targets, although the tight end still finished below 30 receiving yards for the sixth time this season. He remained in a minor role despite the fact the Seahawks were down Rashid Shaheed (knee), and with 21 receptions for 203 yards and zero touchdowns, the third-year pro remains behind the pace of his career-best 52-519-6 line from last season. Barner will look to capitalize on a favorable matchup against the Cardinals defense in a Week 9 home matchup on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Johnston caught all four of his targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Rams.
inj_report.long: Johnston's four grabs marked a new personal single-game high through six games this season. One of the least efficient wideouts in the league, Johnston entered Sunday with just eight grabs for 165 yards on 22 targets. He hasn't been playable in fantasy football for weeks and will square off with a stingy Houston secondary in Week 9.

inj_report.short: Dotson caught two of five targets for 95 yards during Sunday's 16-0 loss to Tampa Bay.
inj_report.long: Dotson and the rest of the Falcons offense were held in check for the majority of Sunday's loss. The wide receiver did provide Atlanta's biggest highlight play of the day, connecting with quarterback Michael Penix for a 76-yard gain on the team's final possession of the day in the fourth quarter. Dotson's 95 yards were a season high, and he has now reeled in 14 of 31 targets for 337 yards and two touchdowns over eight contests to open the 2026 regular season.

inj_report.short: Otton wasn't targeted in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.
inj_report.long: Playing in rain-soaked conditions, the Bucs attempted just three passes all afternoon, as Baker Mayfield failed to complete any of the three. Otton now has posted back-to-back zero-catch games and has minimal fantasy appeal outside of the deepest of TE-premium formats. He has 19 grabs for 186 yards and no touchdowns on 30 targets through eight games.

inj_report.short: Taylor (back) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.
inj_report.long: Taylor was limited Wednesday, but his return to full Thursday puts him on track for his normal role Sunday against the Chiefs. The tight end has been a surprisingly big part of the passing offense this season despite the selection of Kenyon Sadiq in the first round of April's Draft. Taylor has secured 17 of 23 targets for 136 yards and two touchdowns across six games.

inj_report.short: Williams caught five of seven targets for 54 yards during Sunday night's 27-10 win over the Eagles.
inj_report.long: Williams led the team in catches and targets while finishing second behind fellow wide receiver Treylon Burks (81) in receiving yards. With Terry McLaurin (knee) done for the year, Williams will have an opportunity to keep carving out a larger role for himself each week with Washington. On the year, the rookie wide receiver has now reeled in 23 of 33 targets for 259 yards and one touchdown over seven regular-season contests.

inj_report.short: Raymond finished Monday's 34-17 win against Seattle with two catches for 14 yards on three targets along with one rush for 39 yards.
inj_report.long: Raymond's most memorable contribution was a 39-yard dash on a third-down play early in the fourth quarter to take the ball down to Seattle's five-yard line and set up a D'Andre Swift touchdown. Though he didn't put up massive numbers, Raymond's 53 total yards were his most since Week 3 and represented more yardage than he had recorded over his previous four games combined. Raymond remains a shaky fantasy play given his recent numbers, and a Week 9 matchup against a Tampa Bay defense that has been pretty stingy on wideouts doesn't improve his outlook.

inj_report.short: Ekeler rushed eight times for 36 yards in Sunday night's 27-10 win over the Eagles.
inj_report.long: The veteran running back wasn't targeted in the passing game on a night when Jayden Daniels attempted 29 passes. Involved in a three-way backfield that also includes Rachaad White and Jeremy McNichols (foot), Ekeler has minimal fantasy appeal headed into next Sunday's matchup with the Rams' strong defense. Jacory Croskey-Merritt (foot) is required to miss at least one more game on injured reserve.

inj_report.short: Andrews secured both targets for 19 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday night.
inj_report.long: The veteran tight end actually led the Ravens in receiving yards with his modest total, as fill-in signal-caller Joe Fagnano averaged just 3.3 yards per attempt and totaled 60 passing yards overall. Andrews opened the season with back-to-back 49-yard tallies on 10 total catches, but he's been stuck at 28 receiving yards or fewer in his seven subsequent games. Andrews will hope to benefit from the pending trade acquisition of Jacoby Brissett, who should bring some stability and productivity to Baltimore's currently embattled quarterback situation.

inj_report.short: Vidal rushed eight times for 23 yards and caught both of his targets for seven yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Rams.
inj_report.long: The Chargers continue to use a fantasy-unfriendly three-man backfield, giving all three of Vidal, Omarion Hampton and Keaton Mitchell meaningful touches and snaps. In a broken Los Angeles offense and crowded group of RBs, Vidal has minimal fantasy appeal outside of deeper formats.

inj_report.short: Sutton (undisclosed) briefly left Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.
inj_report.long: Sutton went to the medical tent after taking a hard hit, but the wideout was able to return to action not long after he did so. In the process he'll bolster a Denver Week 9 WR corps that also includes Jaylen Waddle, Troy Franklin, Marvin Mims and Lil'Jordan Humphrey.

inj_report.short: Corum rushed 11 times for 73 yards and a touchdown and failed to bring in his only target in the Rams' 24-9 win over the Chargers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Corum led the Rams in rushing yards despite logging five fewer carries than Kyren Williams, and, like the latter, Corum was able to get into the end zone. Corum's score came early in the third quarter on a winding 23-yard run, his second in as many games. The third-year back now has double-digit carries in consecutive games for the second time this season, and he's averaging a career-best 5.2 yards per carry heading into a Week 9 road matchup against the Commanders next Sunday.

inj_report.short: Gainwell (hip) was a full practice participant Thursday, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.
inj_report.long: Gainwell also tended to a hip injury last week, when he got back to full by Friday, but he still entered the weekend listed as questionable for Week 8 action. He proceeded to suit up this past Sunday against the Falcons and split Tampa Bay's backfield with Bucky Irving, logging a 50 percent snap share and going for 140 yards on 25 carries in rainy conditions. Considering Gainwell followed up Wednesday's limited session with an uncapped one Thursday, he's good to go for Sunday's road showdown with the Bears.

inj_report.short: Kupp caught one of three targets for a seven-yard touchdown Monday in a loss to the Bears.
inj_report.long: Kupp had another low target share, but he at least made the most of his only catch by hauling in a seven-yard TD early in the fourth quarter. That score probably isn't going to be enough to inspire confidence in him in fantasy, though, given that the veteran wideout has drawn three or fewer targets in six of his eight games this season. Kupp's seven receiving yards Monday also were a season-low mark, and there simply doesn't seem to be much room for any wideout aside from Jaxon Smith-Njigba to regularly find success in Seattle's offense given Smith-Njigba's massive target share. With that said, Kupp at least will have a favorable matchup in Week 9, as he'll face an Arizona defense that has surrendered 11 receiving TDs to wideouts this season, tied for the most in the NFL.

inj_report.short: Waller corralled one of two targets for 11 yards during last Thursday's 27-19 loss at Green Bay.
inj_report.long: Waller has been hit or miss from a fantasy perspective this season, with two touchdown grabs in Week 2 in Atlanta and a 50-yard TD catch in Week 7 against the Buccaneers serving as the notable performances. Otherwise, he has one 50-yard effort in his five other appearances, sitting on a 15-209-3 line on 25 targets on the season. Waller next takes aim at the tough Broncos defense this coming Sunday.

inj_report.long: Hollins' last game appearance came back in Week 4, but with his return to practice on the horizon, he could be an option for the Patriots as soon as this Sunday's game against the Packers. With Romeo Doubs (shoulder) currently on IR and A.J. Brown's (ankle/knee) availability for Week 9 looking cloudy, Hollins could have a chance at claiming a meaningful role right off the bat if he's cleared to play versus Green Bay. Prior to sustaining the calf injury, Hollins logged a 15-209-0 receiving line on 20 targets through New England's first four games.

If the veteran tight end is unable to practice in at least some capacity Friday, he'll likely be ruled out for Sunday's game against the Packers, paving the way for rookie third-round pick Eli Raridon to take on an expanded role.

inj_report.short: Higbee caught one of two targets for 14 yards against the Chargers in Sunday's 24-9 victory.
inj_report.long: Higbee logged a hearty 83 percent offensive snap share, most among Rams tight ends. However, he got little attention from quarterback Matthew Stafford, recording just two targets. Higbee had a nice run in Weeks 3-5, when he logged 18 catches for 212 yards across the three-game span. However, since then he's posted just seven receptions for 50 yards across his subsequent three contests. As such, it's hard to trust Higbee on a week-to-week basis right now even with the Rams down multiple pass catchers in Davante Adams (hamstring - IR), Terrance Ferguson (ankle - IR) and Colby Parkinson (ribs).

inj_report.short: Monangai (thumb/toe) didn't practice Thursday.
inj_report.long: Monangai also missed Wednesday's walkthrough due to the turf-toe injury that has sidelined him the last four contests. With no activity to speak of so far and just one more chance to practice this week, he seems to be trending toward another absence Sunday against the Buccaneers, something that may be confirmed on Friday's injury report. D'Andre Swift will continue to pace the Bears backfield for as long as Monangai is sidelined, with Roschon Johnson on hand for any RB reps that linger.

inj_report.short: Mitchell reverted to the Eagles' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
inj_report.long: Mitchell was heavily involved in Philadelphia's loss at Washington in Week 8, carrying the ball 11 times for 34 yards and adding four catches on six targets for three yards. Starter Saquon Barkley was in and out of Sunday's contest with a back injury, and he was less effective than Mitchell as a rusher. Mitchell can be elevated from the practice squad once more this season before the Eagles would have to sign him to the active roster for him to be allowed to suit up for regular-season games.

inj_report.short: Coleman (shoulder) was limited in practice Thursday.
inj_report.long: It's a new injury for Coleman, who is on the injury report for the first time since Week 4. With both DJ Moore (knee) and Dalton Kincaid (chest) healthy last Sunday against the Ravens, Coleman caught just one pass for four yards on three targets.

inj_report.short: McGowan rushed five times for 29 yards and returned four kickoffs for 103 yards Sunday in a loss to the Jaguars.
inj_report.long: McGowan's best run was a 16-yarder up the middle midway through the third quarter to take the ball to Jacksonville's three-yard line. That set up Indianapolis' only touchdown in the blowout loss. McGowan logged a modest 15 offensive snaps to starter Jonathan Taylor's 38, but the former outgained Taylor on the ground, 29-23. Meanwhile, DJ Giddens paced the Colts with 43 rushing yards on six totes. The big story, of course, is that the Colts are entertaining trade offers on Taylor, and if the star RB is ultimately dealt, McGowan and Giddens both figure to take on significantly larger roles, though it's unclear which of the two would become the starter. With that in mind, it's worth noting that Giddens didn't enter until the fourth quarter and racked up all of his yardage in garbage time.

inj_report.short: Watkins brought in three of six targets for 56 yards in the 49ers' 29-20 loss to the Falcons on Sunday.
inj_report.long: With the 49ers' receiving corps down all of Mike Evans (Achilles), Deebo Samuel (hamstring), De'Zhaun Stribling (IR, ankle) and Demarcus Robinson (IR, ankle), Watkins saw an expanded role and made good use of the opportunity. All three of Watkins' catches went for first downs, and he finished third on the team in receiving yards and targets while also tying for that slotting in receptions. The 2025 fourth-round pick's performance was encouraging, but he's likely to slide back down the depth chart since the wide-receiver room could be much healthier by the time San Francisco returns to action against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 8, following the Week 8 bye.

inj_report.short: Black rushed 12 times for 63 yards and a touchdown and brought in one of three targets for minus-4 yards in the 49ers' 29-20 loss to the Falcons on Sunday. He also lost a fumble and returned one kickoff for 34 yards.
inj_report.long: Christian McCaffrey suffered a thigh injury in the opening period that eventually led to him missing the entire second quarter, affording Black expanded opportunity. The rookie made good use of the extra touches, averaging a career-high 5.3 yards per carry and recording his highest rushing yardage total since his Week 1 NFL debut. Black also rang up his first TD as a professional, a 30-yard breakaway run on the first play of the second quarter. However, the rookie made a key mistake when he lost a fumble with San Francisco nearing the red zone in the second quarter. McCaffrey did return to the game for the second half and now has the Week 8 bye to recover, so Black could be back to a more reduced role in a Week 9 home matchup against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 8.

inj_report.short: Perine rushed four times for 10 yards and caught his lone target for nine yards in Sunday's 43-36 overtime win over the Titans.
inj_report.long: The Bengals were chasing the Titans on the scoreboard much of the afternoon, and Chase Brown and Perine combined for just 16 carries, as Joe Burrow fired off 48 pass attempts. Perine is a touchdown-or-bust desperation RB3 in fantasy whose main value comes in the form of being Brown's backup. Cincinnati has been linked to a potential trade for a running back ahead of next week's deadline.

inj_report.short: Bryant (ankle) was a full participant at the Broncos' practice Wednesday, Aric DiLalla of the team's official site reports.
inj_report.long: After being designated for return from injured reserve Wednesday, Bryant was back on the practice field with no restrictions. With a bye looming for the Broncos in Week 10, it's unclear if the team will decide to activate the wide receiver before Sunday's matchup with the Panthers. Regardless of whatever decision the team makes, Bryant appears to be fully recovered from the ankle injury that has sidelined him since Week 4.

inj_timeline.note: Bryant (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the 49ers, Chris Tomasson of The Denver Gazette reports.
Bryant is expected to miss "a few weeks" after spraining his right ankle in Sunday's 24-14 loss to the 49ers, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
The Broncos are confident that Bryant avoided a long-term right ankle injury after an MRI on Monday yielded good news, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

inj_report.short: Johnson carried the ball once for 15 yards and caught all five of his targets for 128 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos. He added 44 yards on his only kickoff return.
inj_report.long: The rookie running back flashed his explosiveness on a 73-yard catch-and-run in the second quarter that produced Johnson's first career NFL touchdown. He came into Sunday with a 9-109-0 line on 11 targets through six games, and his six touches were firmly behind Kenneth Walker's 25, but Johnson's breakout performance can only encourage Andy Reid to find more ways to get the ball in his hands. Johnson will look to build on this effort in Week 9 against the Jets.

inj_report.short: Hill rushed nine times for 85 yards and a touchdown and brought in all three targets for seven yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday night.
inj_report.long: Hill provided the sole offensive highlight of the night for the moribund, Joe Fagnano-led offense, making one cut after getting the handoff from the rookie quarterback halfway through the fourth quarter and bursting through the defense up the right side of the field for a 65-yard touchdown run. Hill's yardage total was both a team- and season-high figure for the veteran change-of-pace back, who should benefit from the pending trade acquisition of Jacoby Brissett from the Cardinals whenever the veteran signal-caller is able to take the reins of the offense.

inj_report.long: After missing Week 6 with a hamstring injury, Harris was healthy coming out of the Week 7 bye but played pretty clearly behind both Ladd McConkey and Quentin Johnston against the Rams. Harris ran just 20 routes to McConkey's 34 and Johnston's 30. Harris would see a big boost if Johnston gets traded ahead of next week's deadline.

inj_report.short: Rodriguez rushed 10 times for 19 yards and a touchdown and brought in both targets for 13 yards in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens on Thursday night.
inj_report.long: Rodriguez finished with just two fewer carries than Bhayshul Tuten, who came into the game managing ankle and foot injuries and was able to log a relatively abbreviated workload thanks to game script. Both backs had plenty of trouble against Baltimore's stout run defense, but Rodriguez salvaged his fantasy night with a two-yard TD run just past the midway point of the fourth quarter. Rodriguez now has scored in back-to-back games heading into a Week 10 road matchup against the Titans on Sunday, Nov. 15.

inj_report.short: Cooks caught one of three targets for 13 yards during Sunday's 29-20 loss to Atlanta.
inj_report.long: Cooks was in line to serve as the 49ers' top wide receiver for Week 7 due to the absences of Mike Evans (Achilles) and Deebo Samuel (hamstring). Cooks' 45 offensive snaps were second-most among 49ers wideouts behind Jordan Watkins (50), although the former had only once catch to show for his extra playing time, which didn't happen until the final minute of the fourth quarter. Cooks has three catches (on seven targets) for 33 yards and a touchdown over his last three games, but his role could shrink significantly following the 49ers' Week 8 bye depending on the statuses of Evans, Samuel Christian Kirk and Demarcus Robinson (ankle, IR).

inj_report.short: Henderson (illness) was listed as a non-participant in Thursday's practice, ESPN's Rob Demovsky reports.
inj_report.long: Henderson officially goes down as a non-participant for a second consecutive Week 9 practice and has now missed a full week due to this illness. His participation level will be worth monitoring Friday, though it looks likely at this point that Henderson will carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Packers. Corey Kiner would be in line to maintain an expanded role alongside Rhamondre Stevenson if Henderson sits again Sunday.

If he follows last week's regimen, he'll be limited Friday and enter the weekend listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Rams. While playing through the injury this past Sunday against the Eagles, he tallied a 68 percent snap share and recorded three catches (on five targets) for 81 yards.

inj_report.short: Ferguson (ankle) was a limited practice participant Thursday, Greg Beacham of the Associated Press reports.
inj_report.long: Ferguson has been sidelined since spraining his ankle in Week 3 at Denver, missing the last five games a result. The Rams designated him for return from injured reserve Wednesday, and he's managed two limited sessions since then. Friday's practice report will determine if Ferguson has a chance to return to action Sunday in Washington, but he'll still need to be activated from IR by Saturday afternoon to be in a position to do so.

inj_report.short: Fant gathered in all two targets for 11 yards during Sunday's 16-10 defeat against Pittsburgh.
inj_report.long: After finding the end zone twice in the loss to the Raiders in Week 3, Fant has combined for just three catches in his previous three appearances. While his two receptions Sunday were a small step in the right direction, he is expected to continue to play second fiddle to Juwan Johnson moving forward. It may also be a matter of time before rookie Oscar Delp logs more snaps from week to week.

inj_report.short: Higgins tallied two catches for 10 yards on four targets Sunday in a 33-30 overtime win over Dallas.
inj_report.long: Wideout Michael Wilson missed a portion of the contest due to an injury to his ribs, and Kendrick Bourne (lower leg) exited for good late in the first half. That resulted in a need for other Cardinals pass catchers to step up, and Higgins ended up getting targeted a season-high four times. However, he didn't do much with the opportunity, finishing with his lowest yardage total since he was shut out in Week 2. Meanwhile, No. 1 tight end Trey McBride had another big game with seven catches for 72 yards and a touchdown on eight targets. McBride's elite status will likely continue to make Higgins an afterthought most weeks.

inj_report.short: Chism caught all five of his targets for 37 yards during Sunday's 24-19 win over the Dolphins.
inj_report.long: Chism led the team in targets and receptions, with A.J. Brown (ankle/knee) unavailable. The wide receiver played a season-high 88 percent of the team's offensive snaps, and he has now reeled in 15 of 20 targets for 151 yards and a touchdown over seven regular-season contests with New England so far this year.

inj_report.short: Zaccheaus (shoulder) is active for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers.
inj_report.long: Zaccheaus didn't play in the Week 7 meeting with the 49ers due to a shoulder injury. He was limited during practice throughout the week, though it wasn't enough to avoid a questionable designation for Sunday's divisional clash with Tampa Bay. While the wideout was in danger of missing this contest, he will avoid a second consecutive absence. Zaccheaus has only four catches (11 targets) for 17 yards in six regular-season games in 2026. He also holds a role on special teams as a return man.

The wide receiver's chances to play Sunday versus Arizona seem thin, so Tory Horton could serve as the team's No. 3 option at wide receiver again in Week 9.

inj_report.short: Williams caught his lone target for a 43-yard touchdown during Sunday's 24-19 win over the Dolphins.
inj_report.long: Williams made the most of his only touch in Week 8, scoring on a 43-yard deep ball from Drake Maye in the third quarter. The wide receiver had an opportunity to be more involved with A.J. Brown (knee) sidelined Sunday, but Williams saw just one target for the third game in a row. On the year, the wide receiver has now caught seven of 13 targets for 190 yards and two touchdowns over eight regular-season contests.

inj_report.short: Fields caught four of five targets for 83 yards in Sunday's 27-21 overtime win over Houston.
inj_report.long: In J.J. McCarthy's first start of the season, Fields had his best performance as a pro, capping his day with a 47-yard catch-and-run in the first quarter. The rookie wideout set a new career high in both receiving yards and catches after hauling in exactly two passes in each of his first six games for the Giants. Fields will head into the Giants' bye with a 16-248-1 line on 30 targets before facing the Eagles in Week 9.

inj_report.short: Brown finished Sunday's loss to the Commanders with two catches for 17 yards on two targets.
inj_report.long: With both DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) missing the contest, Brown ranked third among Eagles wideouts with 32 offensive snaps. He didn't do much with the opportunity, as the veteran wideout notched just two receptions for the second straight week. If Smith and/or Wicks return in Week 9 against the Giants, Brown may see his role diminish.

With Terrance Ferguson (ankle) looking like he has a chance to return from injured reserve Sunday against the Commanders, it could be Ferguson, Tyler Higbee and Davis Allen handling tight-end duties.

inj_report.short: Mitchell rushed four times for six yards and caught all three of his targets for 17 yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Rams.
inj_report.long: Handpicked by first-year OC Mike McDaniel as a free-agent signing in the offseason, Mitchell has been a total non-factor for much of the first half of the season. With a career 5.7 yards per carry average, Mitchell is averaging just 3.7 yards per rush this season. Involved in a three-way backfield committee with Omarion Hampton and Kimani Vidal, Mitchell is waiver-wire fodder in normal-sized 12-team fantasy leagues.

inj_report.short: Harrison caught one of four targets for a six-yard touchdown in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants.
inj_report.long: In his second game since being acquired from Arizona via trade, Harrison scored his first touchdown with the Texans. His six-yard touchdown catch in the second quarter was Harrison's lone catch in a game during which six different wide receivers recorded at least one reception for the Texans. Harrison will have an opportunity to increase his knowledge of the playbook during a Week 8 bye and potentially earn more playing time in Houston's crowded wide-receiver room.

inj_report.short: Engram failed to catch any of his three targets in Sunday's 28-24 win over the Chiefs.
inj_report.long: Bo Nix targeted 10 different pass catchers on 32 total pass attempts, and it was rookie RB Jonah Coleman who led the team in receiving with a 4-63-0 line on five targets. Engram has just three catches for 15 yards over his last three games and isn't a recommended fantasy bet ahead of Sunday's date with the Panthers.

inj_report.short: Kiner rushed seven times for 38 yards during Sunday's 24-19 win over Miami.
inj_report.long: Kiner operated as the top reserve option behind starting running back Rhamondre Stevenson in Week 8, with TreVeyon Henderson (illness) sidelined. Kiner has compiled 160 rushing yards on 28 carries while reeling in his only target for seven yards over the team's last four contests, and he could earn more opportunities moving forward.

inj_report.short: Hurst failed to catch his lone target in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.
inj_report.long: Even with Emeka Egbuka (foot) missing a second straight game, Hurst couldn't catch a break, as the game was played in a downpour. Tampa Bay attempted just three passes during the entire game. Hurst has now gone without a catch in back-to-back games without Egbuka in the lineup. Hurst has minimal fantasy appeal outside of being a hold in dynasty formats.

inj_report.short: Goodson took seven carries for 14 yards and caught both of his two targets for 19 yards during Sunday's 33-30 overtime loss versus the Cardinals.
inj_report.long: Dallas wasn't really able to get anything going on the ground in Week 8, totaling just 93 rushing yards on 39 carries. Just like the offense as a whole, Goodson found a bit more success in the passing game, and he posted his best receiving total since back in 2024. As long as starter Javonte Williams remains available, though, Goodson should stay in a change-of-pace role.

inj_report.short: Gadsden caught all five of his targets for 52 yards during Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Rams.
inj_report.long: Gadsden was able to lead the team in catches while he finished with one fewer target than team leader Ladd McConkey. The tight end has now reeled in at least three passes for the second straight game and third time over the last four contests after having failed to do so in any of the team's first three regular-season games. Gadsden and the rest of the Chargers will face a tough test in Week 9 against the Texans.

inj_report.short: TeSlaa caught one of his two targets for 10 yards in the Lions' 20-17 win over the Packers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: TeSlaa played 33 offensive snaps for the Lions in the contest, a 49 percent share of Detroit's offensive plays. However, TeSlaa saw a mere two targets for the second straight game after logging a season-high eight against the Panthers in Week 4, and Sunday's catch was his first since that game as well.

inj_report.short: Meyers failed to catch either of his two targets in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Ravens.
inj_report.long: With Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins both fully healthy, Meyers played just 20 of 53 offensive snaps and ran 16 routes on Joe Burrow's 32 dropbacks. Outside of his 7-82-0 receiving performance in Week 4 against the Jaguars, Meyers has totaled six catches for 59 yards in the other five games.

inj_report.short: Lloyd was limited at practice Thursday due to a knee injury.
inj_report.long: Lloyd's addition to the Packers' practice report midweek is something to monitor, especially because it may indicate a health concern that occurred during Thursday's session. Ultimately, Friday's injury report may provide some clarity into the situation.

inj_timeline.note: Lloyd was limited at practice Thursday due to a knee injury.

inj_report.short: Vaki rushed 11 times for 65 yards in Sunday's 19-15 win over the Vikings. He added one catch for five yards on one target.
inj_report.long: With Jared Goff struggling against the Vikings' blitz-heavy defense, the Lions dished out 34 carries to Jahmyr Gibbs and Vaki. It was Vaki's most extensive action of the season, and coach Dan Campbell said afterward that the Lions' RB2 took a "big step" and earned a lot of trust with his performance, according to Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News. It's unclear if that will translate to more opportunities, but it's clear Vaki has cemented himself as Gibbs' backup and a quality bench stash in fantasy leagues.

inj_report.short: Wright (quadriceps) was limited in Thursday's practice, Marcel Louis-Jacques of ESPN.com reports.
inj_report.long: Wright has been battling various issues all season and hasn't been effective when on the field, yet he's still operating as the Dolphins' lightly-used RB2 behind Ollie Gordon. Wright is averaging a microscopic 1.9 yards per carry this season.

inj_report.short: Gray caught both of his targets for 15 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos.
inj_report.long: The Chiefs' TE2 caught a four-yard score in the third quarter, his first touchdown of the season. Kansas City uses plenty of 12 personnel, deploying both Travis Kelce and Gray on offense, but Gray handles more of the blocking duties. On the season, he has 14 grabs for 173 yards and a touchdown. There isn't much meat on the bone here for fantasy purposes.

inj_report.short: Virgil failed to reel in either of his targets during Sunday's 33-30 overtime victory against Dallas.
inj_report.long: Virgil played a season-high 38 offensive snaps, but he went without a reception for the third straight week. The Cardinals placed Kendrick Bourne (lower leg) on injured reserve Tuesday after the wide receiver fractured his right tibia in Week 8, so more opportunities could come Virgil's way moving forward. Regardless of an increase in workload, the team's Week 9 matchup versus Seattle will be a challenging one for the 22-year-old.

inj_report.short: Treadwell caught one of two targets for 18 yards during Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.
inj_report.long: Treadwell failed to record multiple receptions in a game for the first time since Week 3 against Houston. The wide receiver could be set to operate in a more prominent role if the team decides to deal fellow wideout Josh Downs prior to the trade deadline Nov. 10. For the time being, Treadwell doesn't figure to have much fantasy appeal Sunday against the Cowboys.

inj_report.short: Hutchinson caught three of six targets for 17 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants. He added 12 rushing yards on two attempts.
inj_report.long: On a day in which C.J. Stroud targeted nine different players, Hutchinson tied Dalton Schultz for the team lead with six targets. Nico Collins led the wideout group with 24 routes, but Hutchinson tied Jaylin Noel (toe) for second at the position with 15 routes. In a receiver room that is running six deep on game days, none of these Houston wide receivers are reliably playable in fantasy outside of Collins.

inj_report.short: Jeudy did not catch his lone target Sunday in Cleveland's 27-6 loss to Pittsburgh.
inj_report.long: Quarterback Deshaun Watson had a relatively productive day with 324 passing yards (albeit without a score), but Jeudy was on the receiving end of only one of his passes. The veteran wideout logged his usual amount of playing time, notching a 60 percent offensive snap share to finish third among Cleveland wide receivers. It was the third time this season Jeudy has finished without a catch, but the other two instances were in Weeks 3 and 4, and he had been more involved of late, averaging 3.5 catches and 36.3 receiving yards over his previous four games. With that in mind, he could get back on track in Week 9 against a New Orleans defense that has been middle-of-the-pack against wideouts this year.

inj_report.short: Johnson did not garner a target during Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.
inj_report.long: Johnson and the rest of the Buccaneers' pass catchers went without receptions in Week 8 as quarterback Baker Mayfield failed to complete a pass on three attempts in the team's rain-soaked victory. The wide receiver may have another chance to operate in a prominent role on offense if fellow wideout Emeka Egbuka (foot) remains unavailable Sunday versus the Bears.

inj_report.short: Sadiq caught one of two targets for 22 yards in Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders.
inj_report.long: The rookie tight end played 31 of 64 offensive snaps against Las Vegas and ran just 15 routes on Geno Smith's 35 dropbacks. Sadiq continues to play behind Mason Taylor, who recorded three grabs for 19 yards on five targets across 19 routes. The Jets are using four tight ends on game days, and this offense isn't able to support more than a couple pass catchers for fantasy each week. Outside of his 7-105-1 receiving performance in Week 3 against the Lions, Sadiq has a total of 10 catches for 79 yards across his seven other contests.

inj_report.long: Bech returned from a four-game absence due to a forearm injury and logged a 40 percent offensive snap share, but he didn't get any looks from QB Kirk Cousins. In fact, Cousins didn't go to his wideout corps as a whole very often -- 16 of his 26 targets went to tight ends, and another four went to running back Ashton Jeanty. Bech will look to get back into the box score Sunday in a Week 9 matchup in San Francisco.

inj_report.short: Boutte caught one of two targets for 25 yards during Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss versus the Giants.
inj_report.long: Boutte played a season-low 18 offensive snaps in Week 7, trailing behind Nico Collins (34) and Xavier Hutchinson (31) and tying with Jaylin Noel (toe). Predictably, Boutte wasn't very involved in an inefficient passing game. As recent trade acquisition Marvin Harrison gets acclimated, Boutte's role probably will continue to shrink as the campaign continues.

inj_report.short: Thomas has drawn interest from other teams leading up to the Nov. 10 trade deadline, Ian Rapoport of ESPN reports.
inj_report.long: Since delivering an 87-1,282-10 receiving line over 17 games as a rookie in 2024, Thomas' production has cratered in the ensuing two seasons. He's been firmly behind Parker Washington and Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) in terms of snap share through the Jaguars' first seven games and has drawn more than three targets in just one of those contests. Though the vertical threat Thomas presents might make him an appealing target for teams seeking a big-play receiver, it's unclear if the Jaguars have much motivation to move him. Despite his declining role within the Jacksonville offense, Thomas remains under contract through next season at relatively modest cap hits of $4.01 million in 2026 and $4.66 million in 2027.

inj_report.short: Cameron did not catch his lone target in a 42-7 rout of the Colts on Sunday. He returned one punt for six yards and one kickoff for 18 yards.
inj_report.long: Jacksonville didn't need to go to its air-game much given the easy win, and QB Trevor Lawrence threw just 14 passes. None of those went to Cameron -- his only target (which he didn't catch) came from backup signal-caller Quinn Ewers in garbage time. Cameron did log a season-high 52 percent offensive snap share, but game script didn't do him any favors in terms of production. With no catches in three of his seven games this season, Cameron doesn't make for an appealing fantasy asset.

inj_report.short: Kolar caught one of four targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Rams.
inj_report.long: The tight end's four targets tied for third on the team, as he ran 17 routes on Justin Herbert's 37 dropbacks against Los Angeles. More of a blocker than receiver, Kolar has been forced to catch more passes out of necessity at times this season. He has 10 grabs for 98 yards on 17 targets. The catches and targets are both career highs in his fifth season.

inj_report.short: Williams caught an 18-yard touchdown on his lone target in Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders.
inj_report.long: Williams ran a total of one route on Geno Smith's 35 dropbacks against Las Vegas, but he made it count with a red-zone touchdown. The Jets' fourth receiver behind Garrett Wilson, Adonai Mitchell and Omar Cooper, Williams has no fantasy appeal headed into next Sunday's date with the Chiefs.

inj_report.short: Horton recorded three receptions for 26 yards on six targets in Monday's 34-17 loss to the Bears.
inj_report.long: Horton was on the field for 43 of the Seahawks' 63 offensive snaps, with his 68 percent share representing a season high. The six targets were also a season-best total for Horton, who was the main beneficiary of extra playing time due to the absence of Rashid Shaheed (knee). If Shaheed is cleared to play in the Seahawks' Week 9 game against the Cardinals, Horton will likely see his role get reduced.

inj_report.short: Jennings (calf) was limited in Thursday's practice.
inj_report.long: It's a new injury for Jennings, but he has an extra day to recover this week, as the Vikings play the Bills on Monday night. Jennings has six grabs for 54 yards on 10 targets across six games this season and is nowhere near fantasy relevance in his current role.

inj_report.short: Moreau played 21 offensive snaps and nine special-teams snaps in the Texans' 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Moreau did not appear in the box score of Sunday's game. The tight end's complete lack of offensive production was in stark contrast to his Week 6 two-touchdown effort against the Jaguars in London, and Moreau's week-to-week production figures to remain erratic while working behind clear No. 1 option Dalton Schultz.

inj_report.short: Metchie recorded three receptions for 14 yards on three targets in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
inj_report.long: Metchie took the field for 33 of the Panthers' 73 snaps on offense, placing him behind Tetairoa McMillan (65 snaps) and Jalen Coker (63) but ahead of Brycen Tremayne (19) and David Moore (zero) among Carolina receivers. Though he's now drawn at least three targets in five straight games, Metchie has found the end zone just once and is averaging 22.8 receiving yards per contest during that stretch.

inj_report.short: Nailor caught all four targets for 38 yards in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.
inj_report.long: Both the catches and yards marked new season highs for Nailor, who entered Sunday with eight grabs for 75 yards and no touchdowns across six games. No team uses its receivers less than the Raiders, and Nailor accounted for four of the five targets between him and Tre Tucker against the Jets. Nailor has minimal fantasy appeal headed into next Sunday's road date with the 49ers.

inj_report.short: Holani carried once for nine yards and failed to haul in his lone target in Monday's 34-17 loss to the Bears. He also returned six kickoffs for 144 yards.
inj_report.long: With the Seahawks clearing Zach Charbonnet (knee) to make his season debut and with Jadarian Price (chest) coming off injured reserve, Holani predictably saw his playing time out of the backfield take a hit. He was on the field for just 11 of the Seahawks' 63 offensive snaps, with his season-low 17 percent snap share placing him comfortably behind Price (48 percent) and Charbonnet (37 percent) but ahead of Emanuel Wilson (zero snaps). For the first time all season, Holani was called upon to serve as the Seahawks' primary kickoff returner, as Rashid Shaheed (knee) and Velus Jones (hamstring) were inactive Monday.

inj_report.short: Dell caught his only target for 43 yards and added a two-yard rush during Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants.
inj_report.long: Dell made his return to action after missing nearly two full years while recovering from a dislocated kneecap and a series of torn ligaments in his left knee. The wide receiver was on the field for only 11 offensive plays, but he made the most of his one target. Dell reeled in a deep ball from C.J. Stroud in the second quarter, churning out a 43-yard gain. With Nico Collins, Marvin Harrison, Xavier Hutchinson, Jaylin Noel (toe) and Kayshon Boutte also in the mix at wide receiver, Dell may have a hard time getting many looks each week.

inj_report.long: Johnson appears to be back to full health after missing the team's last two contests while nursing a neck injury. The 25-year-old will be back in his No. 2 role at tight end behind starter Isaiah Likely against the Eagles on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Knox caught one of two targets for six yards in Sunday's 36-10 win over the Ravens.
inj_report.long: It's a typical receiving line for Knox, whose main contributions come in the blocking department. Knox has nine grabs for 42 yards and one touchdown across seven appearances this season. He'd likely need multiple wideout and tight-end injuries to be a fantasy consideration.

inj_report.short: Coleman caught all three of his targets for 46 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots.
inj_report.long: Coleman led the team in receiving yards while reeling in multiple passes for the second time this season. The wide receiver's biggest moment of the game came in the fourth quarter when he connected with quarterback Malik Willis for a 35-yard score with 2:04 remaining in regulation. Coleman hasn't been a consistent part of the team's offensive approach this season, catching eight of 21 targets for 82 yards and two scores over seven contests so far.

inj_report.short: Palmer (hamstring) did not practice Thursday.
inj_report.long: The veteran wideout was injured in Sunday's win over the Ravens and was unable to return to the contest. If he's unable to play Monday night against the Vikings, Skyler Bell and Greg Dortch could see additional work on offense.

inj_report.short: Roush went without a target while playing 37 of the Bears' 70 snaps on offense in Monday's 34-17 win over the Seahawks.
inj_report.long: With Cole Kmet landing on injured reserve with a season-ending knee injury, Roush stepped into an increased role on offense, as his 53 percent snap share represented a season-best mark. However, the added playing time didn't translate to any involvement in the passing game, as Roush ran just 12 routes on the night. The Bears' frequent usage of two-tight-end formations should continue to prop up Roush's snap counts, but he's likely to be utilized mainly as a blocker when he's on the field.

inj_report.short: Turpin (ribs) did not practice Wednesday, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.
inj_report.long: Turpin has missed the past two contests with the injury, and his Week 9 prep isn't off on the right foot. Jonathan Mingo and Camden Brown handled reserve wideout duties behind CeeDee Lamb, George Pickens (hamstring) and Ryan Flournoy last Sunday against the Cardinals.

Adkins now has six grabs for 44 yards and a score on seven targets this season. He has no fantasy appeal.

However, since Brown hasn't been very involved throughout the 2026 campaign, his absence wouldn't open up many opportunities for others.

inj_report.long: Brown had the most productive game of his NFL career thus far, catching more passes than he had in his previous five appearances combined. However, despite the recent uptick in offensive snaps, it's unknown if Brown will continue to be more involved as a pass catcher moving forward.

inj_report.long: Moore was held without a catch for the first time since Week 5, failing to take advantage of DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) being unavailable. Moore figures to remain an afterthought on offense in Week 9 against the Giants.

inj_report.short: Blue caught his lone target for nine yards in Sunday night's 27-10 loss to the Commanders.
inj_report.long: It was the running back's first action of the regular season after he was signed to the active roster last week. Blue logged eight offensive snaps and sits behind Saquon Barkley and Elijah Mitchell on the depth chart. With Tank Bigsby (IR, abdomen) likely due back in the near future, Blue's stay on the 53-man roster could be short.

inj_report.short: Tremayne finished with an 11-yard reception on his lone target in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
inj_report.long: Tremayne took the field for 19 of the Panthers' 73 snaps on offense, with his 26-percent share marking his lowest rate since Week 2. The 26-year-old appears to have been passed up on the depth chart at receiver by John Metchie, who logged 33 snaps Thursday and has now had higher playing-time shares than Tremayne for three straight games.

inj_timeline.note: The Bills designated Shavers (knee) to return from the reserve/PUP list Wednesday, but he will not play against the Ravens on Sunday, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

inj_report.short: Duvernay caught both of his targets for 14 yards while also adding 75 yards as a kick returner and 12 punt-return yards during Sunday's 33-30 overtime win against the Cowboys.
inj_report.long: Duvernay reeled in his first two passes of the year while playing 34 offensive snaps in the victory. Fellow wideout Kendrick Bourne (lower leg) fractured his right tibia during the contest, and he is likely set to miss the rest of the 2026 campaign. Duvernay will likely see an increased role on offense in Bourne's absence, but he will remain an unappealing fantasy option ahead of the team's Week 9 matchup against Seattle.

inj_report.long: Even with David Montgomery (groin) and Jawhar Jordan (quadriceps) injured and inactive, Ogunbowale played just seven offensive snaps behind Woody Marks' 54. Ogunbowale can continue to be ignored in fantasy football.

inj_report.short: Lance reeled in all two targets for 12 yards during Sunday's 16-10 loss to Pittsburgh.
inj_report.long: Lance had two catches for the second consecutive game, though unlike the Week 6 win over the Giants, he didn't find the end zone. The 24-year-old has logged 332 offensive snaps this season, third in the receiving corps behind Chris Olave (387) and Devaughn Vele (438). However, despite being on the field more often than most of the other wideouts on the roster, Lance hasn't been productive thus far in his rookie campaign.

inj_report.short: Bond went without a target while taking the field for eight of the Browns' 70 snaps on offense in Sunday's 27-6 loss to the Steelers. He returned one kickoff for 26 yards.
inj_report.long: Since posting a 3-74-0 receiving line on seven targets in a Week 5 loss to the Jets, Bond has settled back into a muted role on offense. He's logged single-digit snaps in three straight contests, going without a target in each of those games.

inj_report.short: Njoku (fibula) was limited in Thursday's practice.
inj_report.long: Njoku had his 21-day practice window opener Wednesday, and he's logged back-to-back limited practice sessions to begin Week 9 work. He's been on the shelf since going down with the lower leg injury in Week 2.

inj_report.short: Cuevas caught one of two targets for 15 yards during Sunday's 36-10 loss at Buffalo.
inj_report.long: Cuevas played 13 offensive snaps in Week 8, again trailing behind veteran Mark Andrews (29) and rookie fourth-rounder Matthew Hibner (21). With that said, Cuevas ran routes on most of those snaps, and he drew multiple targets for the fourth straight game Sunday. He still won't be a viable fantasy option in most formats as long as Andrews and Hibner remain healthy.

inj_report.short: Cowing caught three of five passes for 38 yards, added a 10-yard carry and returned one kickoff for 28 yards during Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
inj_report.long: Cowing and the other 49ers pass catchers operated in expanded roles Sunday due to the absences of both Mike Evans (Achilles) and Deebo Samuel (hamstring). Cowing was on the field for 26 of the 49ers' 66 offensive snaps (39.4 percent), which was third most behind Jordan Watkins (50) and Brandin Cooks (45). Cowing put up season highs in catches, receiving yards and rushing yards, but his role could shrink significantly following the 49ers' Week 8 bye depending on the statuses of Evans, Samuel, Christian Kirk and Demarcus Robinson (ankle, IR), with rookie second-rounder De'Zhaun Stribling (ankle, IR) not expected back until December, per David Lombardi of SFStandard.com.

inj_report.short: Kacmarek (hamstring) was a limited participant at the Dolphins' practice Wednesday.
inj_report.long: Kacmarek was limited at practice throughout the entire week before playing 19 offensive snaps and six snaps on special teams during the team's 24-19 loss to the Patriots in Week 8. The tight end may be set for a similar fate ahead of Sunday's matchup with the Lions as he continues to nurse a hamstring injury.

inj_report.short: Fehoko is listed as a starting receiver on the Cardinals' unofficial depth chart heading into Sunday's game at Seattle, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.
inj_report.long: Buried on the depth chart at receiver to begin the season, Fehoko mostly served as a special-teams contributor through the Cardinals' first seven games. However,the Cardinals have since traded away Marvin Harrison before losing Jalen Brooks (wrist) and Kendrick Bourne (tibia) to season-ending injuries within the past two weeks, so Fehoko suddenly finds himself in a position to contribute. Fehoko played double-digit snaps for the first time in 2026 on Sunday, coincidentally against his former teams the Cowboys. He wasn't much of a factor in a comeback win, however, earning just one target for a 17-yard reception while taking the field for 40 of the team's 81 offensive play. While Fehoko could see his playing time climb even higher in Week 9, tight ends Trey McBride and Elijah Higgins, wideout Michael Wilson (ribs) and running back Tyler Allgeier may be better bets to command targets from quarterback Gardner Minshew.

Allen ran 22 routes on Patrick Mahomes' 44 dropbacks, but with both Rice and Worthy healthy alongside Travis Kelce and Kenneth Walker, there doesn't appear to be much juice to squeeze for Allen.

inj_report.short: Wilson played just seven snaps -- all on special teams -- in Monday's 34-17 loss to the Bears.
inj_report.long: After logging double-digit carries in six of the Seahawks' previous seven games while scoring four touchdowns and averaging 66.4 scrimmage yards during that span, Wilson fell out of the game plan entirely in Week 8. With Zach Charbonnet (knee) getting cleared to make his 2026 debut, Jadarian Price (chest) returning from injured reserve and George Holani still on hand as an option on passing downs, the Seahawks had no reps available out of the backfield for Wilson. Unless Charbonnet or Price succumbs to another injury, Wilson's playing time on offense will likely remain scarce moving forward.

inj_report.short: James logged a six-yard carry, turned his lone target into an 11-yard catch and registered 119 yards on four kickoff returns during the 49ers' 29-20 loss to the Falcons on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Most of James' on-field work Sunday came on special teams. Both of his touches on offense happened on back-to-back plays in the second quarter, coinciding with the absence of Christian McCaffrey, the latter of whom was playing through a thigh injury during most of Sunday's contest. The only way James would see consistent playing time on offense is if one of McCaffrey or rookie Kaelon Black were to miss time. The 49ers will get some additional rest thanks to the Week 8 bye, and their next game takes place Week 9 against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 8.

inj_report.long: Dortch has been serving as Buffalo's top return man throughout the season, but he continues to see limited involvement as a receiver. The 28-year-old hasn't played more than five offensive snaps in any of his seven appearances and has yet to draw a target.

inj_report.short: Johnson carried five times for 17 yards and added an 11-yard reception on his lone target in Monday's 34-17 win over the Seahawks.
inj_report.long: With Kyle Monangai (toe/thumb) inactive for a fourth straight game, Johnson continued to serve as the No. 2 running back behind D'Andre Swift. inj_report.short: Giddens racked up 43 yards on six carries in Indianapolis' Week 8 loss to Jacksonville on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Giddens entered Sunday having not logged a snap this season, but he got an opportunity in the blowout loss and made the most of it, ripping off a pair of 12-yard runs on the way to a team-leading 43 rushing yards. However, it must be noted that he didn't enter until the game was far out of reach in the fourth quarter, so all of his production came in garbage time. Still, it was a meaningful performance by Giddens in the context of Indianapolis fielding trade offers for star RB Jonathan Taylor amidst a lost season. Should Taylor indeed be dealt, Giddens would immediately take on a more prominent role in the Colts backfield along with seventh-round rookie Seth McGowan.

inj_report.short: The Ravens are finalizing a trade with the Cardinals that will send Brissett to Baltimore, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. The deal is expected to be completed over the weekend.
inj_report.long: Brissett was set to become a free agent this offseason and was demoted from the starting role earlier this week, making him an expendable piece for the Cardinals, who will move forward with Gardner Minshew and Carson Beck as their quarterbacks. Baltimore, meanwhile, had a critical need for an experienced signal-caller after losing  Lamar Jackson (thumb) and Tyler Huntley (foot) to injuries that will send both quarterbacks to injured reserve and potentially keep them out for the rest of the season, so Brissett will fill a void. Since the trade won't be made official for a few more days, Brissett won't be available for the Ravens' Thursday night game against the Jaguars. Undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano will direct the Baltimore offense against Jacksonville, but Brissett could step in as the Ravens' new starter beginning with a Week 10 matchup against the Chargers.

inj_report.short: Watson (concussion) "is unlikely to start" Sunday's game against the Saints, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
inj_report.long: Watson has not practiced since being placed in the NFL's concussion protocol Tuesday, and it appears he will not be cleared to suit up for Week 9. The Browns will provide an official update on Watson's status later Friday, and if he is unable to go, Shedeur Sanders would presumably get the start in his place.

inj_report.short: Chicago signed Carlson from its practice squad to its 53-man roster Wednesday, Brendan Sugrue of USA Today reports.
inj_report.long: When Cole Kmet went to the Bears' injured reserve list with a season-ending knee injury following Week 7, it left the team with just two healthy tight ends on its active roster, so the move gives the club some much-needed depth at the position. As long as starter Colston Loveland and rookie third-rounder Sam Roush remain available, though, Carlson's role will likely be limited as the season progresses.

inj_report.short: Murray likely won't play Monday against the Bills due to a hamstring strain, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.
inj_report.long: Per head coach Kevin O'Connell, Murray is considered week-to-week, paving the way for Carson Wentz to make his second start of the season when the Vikings face the Bills on MNF. Per Lewis, O'Connell said Thursday that a stint on injured reserve isn't under consideration for Murray, suggesting that the starting quarterback's potential absence isn't expected to linger beyond 1-to-3 weeks.

Murray completed 17 of 29 passes for 210 yards with two touchdowns and one interception and rushed four times for 35 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions on Sunday. He also threw a two-point conversion pass and dealt with hamstring tightness during the game, per Alec Lewis of The Athletic.

inj_report.short: Aubrey made three of his four field-goal attempts and all three PATs in the Cowboys' 33-30 overtime loss to the Cardinals.
inj_report.long: Aubrey missed a 61-yard field goal before halftime in a game that ended with a three-point difference. The kicker converted from 31 yards, 35 yards and 41 yards in the contest as the Cowboys offense ended up stalling after long drives multiple times. Aubrey moves to 15-for-19 on field-goal attempts and 20-for-21 on PATs through eight regular-season games in 2026.

inj_report.short: Head coach Andy Reid said that Butker will remain the Chiefs' kicker for Sunday's game against the Jets, Nate Taylor of ESPN.com reports.
inj_report.long: Butker -- who has made 12 of his 18 field-goal attempts in seven games this season -- converted one of his two tries along with with all three point-after attempts in the Chiefs' Week 8 loss to the Broncos. Despite his recent accuracy issues, Butker will retain his kicking role this weekend, even though the Chiefs recently signed Justin Tucker to the practice squad.

inj_report.short: Fitzgerald made both field-goal attempts and converted his only extra-point try in Thursday's 27-19 loss to Green Bay.
inj_report.long: Fitzgerald didn't attempt a kick in the Week 7 loss to Tampa Bay. The 26-year-old got back on the board Thursday, draining a 39-yard field goal early in the first quarter before capping off the night with a 50-yarder late in the third. Fitzgerald has made all 13 of his field goals this season, though he's missed five extra-point attempts.

inj_report.short: Ryland converted both of his field-goal attempts and three of four PATs in Sunday's 33-30 overtime win over the Cowboys.
inj_report.long: Ryland's missed PAT came in the fourth quarter with 1:03 remaining after Michael Wilson's touchdown knotted the game at 30-30. Arizona was lucky to get to overtime, but Ryland made the winning kick with 4:09 remaining, drilling a 42-yard field goal. On the season, he's made 19 of 21 field-goal tries and 16 of 17 extra-point attempts.

inj_report.short: Gay converted his sole field-goal attempt and all five PATs in the Raiders' 38-33 win over the Jets on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Gay converted a 53-yard field goal with 27 seconds remaining in the contest to put the Raiders up five points. The kicker is now 18-for-20 on field-goal attempts and a perfect 19-for-19 on PATs over eight regular-season games in 2026.

inj_report.short: Head coach John Harbaugh reiterated Monday that he's confident in Zvada and said that the Giants have no plans to work out other kickers, Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News reports.
inj_report.long: Though the Giants escaped with a 27-21 overtime win over the Texans on Sunday, Zvada had his second rough performance in the past three weeks. The undrafted rookie out of Michigan was unable to connect on field-goal tries of 44 and 56 yards, giving him five misses on 18 attempts through seven games. The Giants are hoping that their upcoming Week 8 bye will give Zvada some time to iron out kinks and refine his approach before the team returns to action Nov. 8 versus the Eagles.

inj_report.short: Dicker made all three of his field-goal attempts during Sunday's 24-9 loss against the Rams. He did not kick any extra-point tries.
inj_report.long: The Chargers offense put forth another poor effort in Week 8, with four of their 11 drives ending in punts and another three ending with turnovers. Dicker has mostly been efficient through his first seven games of the season, making 12 of his 14 field-goal attempts, but until the offense demonstrates it can consistently move the ball down the field, he'll be hard to trust as a fantasy option.

inj_report.short: McPherson made all five extra-point attempts in Sunday's 43-36 win over the Titans.
inj_report.long: For the second straight week, the Bengals' kicker did not attempt a field goal but connected on all five of his extra-point tries. He's certainly getting scoring attempts in the high-flying Bengals offense, though a few more field-goal tries would boost his fantasy value.

inj_report.short: Moody made his only field-goal attempt and his only extra-point try Thursday in a loss to Jacksonville.
inj_report.long: Baltimore's offense struggled for most of the game, limiting Moody's opportunities. He did hit a 53-yard field goal in the first quarter and was good on the point-after attempt following Justice Hill's 65-yard rushing touchdown midway through the fourth. It was Moody's first appearance of 2026, as he was elevated to the active roster from the practice squad after Tyler Loop (groin) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday. Given his performance Thursday, Moody seems likely to retain his role as Baltimore's kicker for the team's Week 10 matchup against the Chargers.

inj_report.short: McLaughlin made all three field-goal attempts and his only extra-point try in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.
inj_report.long: The kicker connected from 46, 34 and 42 yards as he accounted for a majority of his team's points. McLaughlin has yet to miss this season, hitting 19 field goals and 17 extra points through eight games.

inj_report.short: Szmyt made both of his field-goal attempts in the Browns' 27-6 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Szmyt converted his 31-yard and 32-yard field-goal attempts in the second quarter of Sunday's contest. The kicker accounted for all six of the Browns' points in the divisional loss. Szmyt is now 16-for-18 on field-goal attempts and 11-for-12 on PATs through eight regular-season games in 2026.

inj_report.short: Elliott (ankle) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.
inj_report.long: Elliott was limited for a second consecutive practice. There should be more clarity on his status Friday for the Eagles' Week 9 meeting with the Giants. However, if Elliott is ruled out ahead of that one, the Eagles will presumably hit the open market for a replacement.

inj_report.short: Gonzalez reverted to the Dolphins' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's official transaction log.
inj_report.long: Miami plans to continue using Gonzalez as its starting kicker in Week 9 against Detroit, but the Dolphins will have to use his last practice-squad elevation in order to do so, per David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel. Gonzalez is 2-for-3 on field-goal tries and 5-for-5 on extra-point attempts through two starts this season.

inj_report.short: Stevens made four of his five field-goal attempts and converted his only extra-point try during Sunday's 27-10 win versus the Eagles.
inj_report.long: Stevens had just one blemish in an otherwise great game in Week 8, as he missed a 55-yard attempt after the Commanders' first drive of the game. Regardless, he set a new career high in field goals made in a game. Washington's offense will try to keep up the momentum against a tougher defense in Week 9 versus the Rams.

inj_report.short: Sanders made all four of his field-goal attempts and three PATs in the Jets' 38-33 loss to the Raiders on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Sanders made four shorter field goals from 21 yards, 36 yards, 39 yards and 31 yards in a perfect outing. The kicker worked to redeem himself after a crucial field-goal miss in a three-point loss to the Dolphins during Week 7. Sanders is 17-for-19 on field goals and 13-for-13 on PATs through eight 2026 regular-season games.

inj_report.short: Reichard missed his sole field-goal attempt and made his sole PAT in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Reichard missed a 57-yard field goal on the first drive of the game. The kicker's miss proved costly as the Vikings lost a four-point game that went down to the wire. Reichard is now 18-for-20 on field-goal attempts and 10-for-10 on PATs through seven regular-season games in 2026.

inj_report.short: Little made all four of his field-goal attempts and all three of his extra-point tries in a 33-10 win over Baltimore on Thursday.
inj_report.long: The Jaguars dominated in the victory, but they fell short of the end zone enough times to keep Little busy. He didn't need to fully flex the strength of his leg, as his longest kick was from a modest 47 yards out, but Little extended his run of consecutive successful FG attempts to 10. He's now gone 14-of-16 on field-goal tries this season while converting 25 of 26 point-after attempts.

inj_report.short: Smack converted three of four extra-point tries and didn't attempt a field goal Thursday in a 27-19 win over Carolina.
inj_report.long: Smack's evening began poorly, as he clanged the extra-point attempt off the left upright following Green Bay's first touchdown of the game midway through the first quarter. However, the rookie kicker recovered to make his other three PATs. Still, the missed kick may have put Smack on even thinner ice, and his struggles likely contributed to Green Bay's decision to punt on a fourth-down play from the Panthers' 37-yard line while up eight points late in the fourth period rather than letting him attempt a 54-yard field goal that would have essentially iced the game. On the season, Smack has made 11 of 16 FGAs and 16 of 19 extra points.

inj_report.short: Coach Kellen Moore announced Wednesday that Smyth will be the Saints' kicker in Week 9, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.
inj_report.long: Smythe will take over for the recently released Daniel Carlson. A native of Northern Ireland, Smythe went 12-for-16 on field goals over six games for the Saints in 2025.

Rams head coach Sean McVay announced Monday that Grupe will miss the remainder of the season after sustaining a torn ACL in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Cardinals, Greg Beacham of the Associated Press reports.

inj_report.short: Lutz made both field-goal attempts and both PATs in Sunday's 28-24 win over the Chiefs.
inj_report.long: Lutz's field-goal tries were good from 39 and 45 yards in the first half. Kicking in Denver's anemic offense through eight games, the veteran has made just 14 of 17 FGAs and all 14 PATs. He's not an exciting fantasy kicker despite playing his home games in a kicker-friendly environment.

inj_report.short: Pineiro did not attempt a field goal while going 2-for-3 on PATs in Sunday's 26-20 loss to the Falcons.
inj_report.long: Pineiro went without a field-goal try for the second time this season, and he hasn't made multiple field goals in a contest since Week 1. To make matters worse, the kicker missed an extra-point try for the second straight week, and he's now 21-for-25 on PATs over the first seven games this season. With the 49ers off next week, Pineiro's next chance to be more involved will come in Week 9 against the Raiders.

inj_report.short: Borregales made one of his two field goals and all three PATs in the Patriots' 24-19 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Borregales missed a 40-yard field goal during the Patriots' last drive of the first half. The kicker continues to struggle in the intermediate range, now sitting at 7-for-10 on field-goal attempts from 30-49 yards during the 2026 regular season.

inj_report.short: Folk went 0-for-1 on field-goal tries and did not attempt an extra point in Sunday's 16-0 loss to the Buccaneers.
inj_report.long: The kicker missed wide left from 53 yards out in the first quarter. It was difficult for the Atlanta offense to move the ball in rainy conditions. Folk has failed to connect on four of 16 field-goal tries and one of 16 extra points in 2026.

inj_report.short: The Rams signed Karty to their active roster Thursday.
inj_report.long: Karty was elevated from the practice squad for each of the Rams' previous two games and handled kickoff duties while Brandon McManus kicked field goals and extra points. That arrangement isn't expected to change moving forward, per Nate Adkins of The Athletic, so it would likely take a McManus slump or injury for Karty to get a shot at the fantasy-relevant aspects of the kicker position.

inj_report.short: Santos made both field-goal tries and all four PATs in Monday night's 34-17 win over the Seahawks.
inj_report.long: Santos made 44- and 38-yard field goals in the second quarter. It was a nice bounce-back game for the veteran kicker after he'd missed a field-goal try in each of the previous three games. For the season, Santos is 13-for-17 on FGAs and a perfect 25-for-25 on PATs. Being attached to the Bears offense makes Santos an attractive fantasy kicker.

inj_report.short: Bass made all three of his field-goal attempts as well as three PATs in the Bills' 36-10 win over the Ravens on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Bass converted multiple long-range field goals for the Bills after the offense stalled several times due to drops. The kicker succeeded from 56 yards, 22 yards and 51 yards in the contest. Bass has converted all 16 of his field-goal attempts and is 21-for-23 on PATs through seven games this season.

inj_report.short: Fairbairn went 2-for-2 on field-goal attempts and converted his only PAT in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants.
inj_report.long: Fairbairn finished off each of the Texans' first two scoring drives with field-goal makes from 58 and 57 yards in the first half. The kicker has now converted multiple field goals in four straight contests, and his last miss came all the way back in Week 2 versus Cincinnati. Fairbairn has gone 15-for-16 on field-goal tries, including 6-for-7 from 50-plus yards, while making all 16 of his extra-point attempts over seven contests so far.

inj_report.short: Myers missed his lone field-goal attempt and made one of two PATs in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Bears.
inj_report.long: Myers converted a chip-shot 27-yard field goal in the second quarter but later missed an extra point wide to the left before halftime. He then had a 33-yard field-goal try blocked in the fourth quarter. On the season, the veteran kicker is 14-for-16 on FGAs and 17-for-19 on PATs. He'll be a kicker to stream next Sunday at home against the Cardinals.

inj_report.short: Bates made two of his three field-goal attempts and his sole PAT in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Bates converted field goals from 25 yards and 37 yards while missing a 46-yarder in the third quarter off the left upright. The kicker now is 12-for-13 on field-goal attempts and a perfect 23-for-23 on PATs through seven regular-season games in 2026.

inj_report.short: McManus converted his sole field-goal attempt and all three PATs in the Rams' 24-9 win over the Chargers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: While Joshua Karty handled kickoffs for the Rams, McManus was entrusted with field goals and extra-point tries. The kicker's first field-goal attempt with his new team was a 30-yarder, so the veteran player has not yet been challenged as a Ram.

inj_report.short: Shrader made his sole PAT in the Colts' 42-7 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Shrader did not have a very active night, making the sole kick he was called upon for. He's now 14-for-15 on PATs while remaining 19-for-21 on field-goal attempts through eight regular-season games in 2026.
